packageRules.description: Major updates are paused for this repo. TypeScript 7 is rejected by typescript-eslint (peer '>=4.8.4 <6.1.0'), and ESLint 10 leaves the lockfile unresolvable, so npm ci fails with "lock file's eslint@9 does not satisfy eslint@10". Every narrower hold tried before this one just surfaced the next blocked major in the same grouped PR, so the monthly major stream was pure noise: it could not go green and it held nothing useful. Security updates are unaffected -- vulnerabilityAlerts runs on its own schedule and ignores packageRules. Minor and patch updates continue normally. Delete this rule once typescript-eslint accepts TS 7 and the ESLint 10 upgrade is done deliberately.
